evaluation_protocol.area_definition: COCO default original-image bbox area ranges, IoU 0.50:0.95
notes: Training scheduler remains configured for 200 epochs and stops intentionally at the probe horizon.
Full FP32 evaluation is produced from probe best.pt for screening only.
Official VisDrone scoring should be applied separately with the frozen D27 evaluator.

probe.intervention: E31a per-channel scale + neutral-initialized channel compatibility gate
probe.note: Trainer remains configured for epochs=200. The probe stops at the requested horizon, preserving the formal 200-epoch LR schedule up to that point.

p2_architecture.variant: E31a per-channel scale + neutral-initialized channel compatibility gate
p2_architecture.upsampling: nearest unchanged at layers 11/15/25; DSSG nearest internal alignment unchanged

tal2.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

p2_architecture.claim_boundary: One E18a FusionReady intervention only. DSSG, P2, Detect, auxiliary loss and all training hyperparameters remain frozen.

initialization_check.scope: fresh deterministic E1->E31 initialization only; not enforced on trained checkpoints

preflight_transfer.source: original 80-class yolo11s.pt transferred into deterministic E1, then every E1 tensor mapped exactly into E18a

source_audit.note: P2 fusion and P2 Detect are random; 10-class output layers are reinitialized.

preflight_transfer.note: No experiment best.pt is a parent. E1 backbone/neck/P2/four-scale Detect tensors are exact. Only layers 12,16,28,29 and model.30.aux_head are newly initialized.

implementation.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

matching_equivalence.limits: Synthetic FP32-GT cases and batch8 real-model 128px steps; not a 1024px memory test or a guarantee of identical final AP.

training.memory_note: Probe is intentionally stopped before 200 while keeping the 200-epoch scheduler. Resume snapshot is taken before final_eval.
